uniform pipe: 0.4999 uniform instructions a SMSP-cycle, 2% margin (uz_128i, the fastest form alone; DC's uniform.cuh, each alone: uz_128a 0.500, uz_128f 0.500, uz_128i 0.500, uz_128p 0.500, uz_128x 0.500, uz_64a 0.500, uz_64f 0.500, uz_64i 0.500, uz_64p 0.500, uz_64s 0.500, uz_64x 0.497). A uniform instruction also costs 0.9838 of an issue slot (the least slowdown a uniform instruction adds to an issue-saturated stream, 1.0034 at ux_128x, less 2%; JI rows scaled as the ALU's) and holds no other row: no point beside the chains loads one to its limit; the largest each point allows: M 1.17 (um_64x), A 0.90 (uh_64i), I 1.72 (uh_128a), SHFL 2.04 (uz_128i), JPI90_0 1.72 (uh_128a), JPI90_1 2.04 (uz_128i), JPA90_0 0.90 (uh_64i), JPA90_1 2.04 (uz_64p), JPSHFL90_0 2.04 (uz_128i)

A-DISPATCH: a SMSP's scheduler issues at most 1 warp instruction a SMSP-cycle, of any kind, uniform included (the SM's 4 partitions each with one warp scheduler and one dispatch unit: Volta-onward architecture whitepapers)

A-TENSOR: the tensor cores do at most the data sheet's dense peak a SM-clock for the form's type, a 2:4 sparse form twice that on its logical k; a form's SMSP-cycles are its MACs over a quarter of it. H100/H200 (whitepaper: twice A100's MMA rate a SM-clock on each type; data sheet 1979 TOPS s8 dense at 1830 MHz, 132 SMs): dense MACs a SM-clock s8 and e4m3 4096, f16/bf16 2048, tf32 1024, the same for wgmma and mma.sync; no b1 figure (BGMMA, BMMA on DS_issue alone)

A-PIPE: the alu pipe (Nsight Compute: logic, bit manipulation, integer except IMAD/IMUL) at 64 results a SM-clock (CUDA C++ Programming Guide 12.9 'Arithmetic Instructions' throughput table, CC 9.0: 32-bit add, compare/min/max, bitwise, shift), 2 SMSP-cycles a warp instruction

A-PIPE: IMAD at 64 results a SM-clock (CUDA C++ Programming Guide 12.9 'Arithmetic Instructions' throughput table, CC 9.0: 32-bit integer multiply, multiply-add), 2 SMSP-cycles a warp instruction; FFMA at 128 is held by DS_issue
A-PIPE: SHFL at 32 results a SM-clock (CUDA C++ Programming Guide 12.9 'Arithmetic Instructions' throughput table, CC 9.0: warp shuffle), 4 SMSP-cycles a warp instruction
